DATAFIELD.name: //webHarvy에 넣을 유니코드(\u0008)제거 코드 + 이모지 function removeSpecificCharacters(text) { const specificCharsRegex =/[\u{1F600}-\u{1F64F}\u{1F300}-\u{1F5FF}\u{1F680}-\u{1F6FF}\u{1F700}-\u{1F77F}\u{1F780}-\u{1F7FF}\u{1F800}-\u{1F8FF}\u{1F900}-\u{1F9FF}\u{1FA00}-\u{1FA6F}\u{1FA70}-\u{1FAFF}\u{2600}-\u{26FF}\u{2700}-\u{27BF}\u{2300}-\u{23FF}\u{25A0}-\u{25FF}\u{2B50}\u{2B55}\u{2934}\u{2935}\u{2B05}\u{2B06}\u{2B07}\u{2B1B}\u{2B1C}\u{2B50}\u{2B55}\u{3030}\u{303D}\u{3297}\u{3299}\u{FE0F}\u0008]/gu; return text.replace(specificCharsRegex, ''); } function cleanTextNodes(node) { if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) node.textContent = removeSpecificCharacters(node.textContent); else node.childNodes.forEach(cleanTextNodes); } cleanTextNodes(document.body);
